Lower Text: ＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 2 level 6 or higher cards among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Dark Masters] trait from your hand to an empty space in your breeding area without paying the cost.
